subject.title: Group chat context handling can blur which messages are addressed to the current agent

question: What target-attribution contract should OpenClaw expose for multi-agent Telegram group history and reply context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API needs maintainer intent around sibling-bot identity, unknown versus no-target semantics, and whether ambient history remains visible, summarized, or filtered.

options.title: Add Metadata Contract
options.body: Define optional per-message target metadata and reply-target fields, keep existing history visible by default, and require Telegram population plus live proof before closing.

options.title: Accept Prompt Mitigation
options.body: Treat clearer group prompt wording as the near-term product answer and keep durable metadata as a later separate design.

options.title: Add Context Isolation Policy
options.body: Introduce an explicit filtering/summarization policy for multi-bot groups, accepting the extra config and upgrade proof burden.

recommendation.title: Add Metadata Contract
recommendation.body: Define optional per-message target metadata and reply-target fields, keep existing history visible by default, and require Telegram population plus live proof before closing.
